text:
Xavier moves the whistle to the wicker basket. Then Dalia moves it to the blue drawer, and no later move changes its location.

ANSWER: C

Emeka’s latest information is Xavier’s private message saying the whistle is in the wicker basket. Emeka is outside the attic for the later events, so he does not hear Xavier say it is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: D

Rania last knew the whistle was in the white cabinet before leaving. After she returned, she saw Dalia move it to the blue drawer, and then heard Xavier say it was there.

ANSWER: C

Xavier’s final announcement says the whistle is in the blue drawer, and Farah, Emeka, and Dalia are all in the attic to hear it. Each believes what they hear, so Farah thinks Emeka thinks Dalia thinks Emeka thinks it is in the blue drawer.

ANSWER: B

Emeka’s latest information is Xavier’s private text saying the whistle is in the wicker basket. Emeka is outside the attic when Dalia moves it and when Xavier speaks, so he gets no newer information.

ANSWER: D

The supplier changes at event 41, when Mirela switches it to Brightwater. That is the final change, so Brightwater is the actual supplier.

ANSWER: D

Emeka’s latest information is Xavier’s text saying the whistle is in the wicker basket. He does not hear Xavier’s later announcement in the attic, so he will open the wicker basket first.

ANSWER: D

Nadim’s latest information is Amara’s direct message at event 40 saying the supplier is Halcyon. Event 41 is on a call he isn’t listening to, so he learns nothing from it. His misleading message to Wanjiru at event 38 doesn’t change what he believes.

ANSWER: B

Mirela is on the final call and switches the packaging supplier to Brightwater, so she thinks Brightwater is the supplier.

ANSWER: C

Soren sees Farah move the whistle to the blue drawer, so he thinks she believes it is there. He doesn’t know about Rania’s later private message to Farah.

ANSWER: B

Nadim’s latest information is Amara’s message at step 40 saying the supplier is Halcyon. He is not on the later calls where the supplier changes.

ANSWER: D

Xavier texted Emeka that the whistle was in the wicker basket, and Xavier knew Emeka read it. So Xavier thinks Emeka believes it is in the wicker basket. Emeka gets no later update, and Xavier knows Emeka is outside and cannot hear his final statement.

ANSWER: D

At event 22, Farah hears Mirela tell Wanjiru that the supplier is Sablewood, so Farah thinks Wanjiru believes Sablewood. At event 24, Farah sends Wanjiru a message saying Northwind; Wanjiru reads it immediately and, under the story’s rules, believes it. Farah learns of no later updates to Wanjiru’s belief.

ANSWER: A

At event 41, Mirela and Goran are both on the call. Goran hears Mirela switch the supplier to Brightwater, so Mirela thinks Goran believes it is Brightwater.

ANSWER: A

At step 22, Farah knows Wanjiru heard Mirela say Sablewood. At step 24, Farah sends Wanjiru the misleading message “Northwind”; Farah knows Wanjiru believes what she is told. Farah does not know about Wanjiru’s later private messages or secret listening, so Farah expects Wanjiru to answer Northwind.

ANSWER: A

Hana sees Emeka in the attic when Soren moves the whistle to the wooden chest, so she thinks Emeka learns it is there. Emeka leaves afterward. Hana does not learn the contents of the later private message Xavier sends Emeka, so her belief about Emeka’s belief remains “wooden chest.”

ANSWER: A

On the final call, Soren, Goran and Farah are all present. They hear Mirela switch the supplier to Brightwater, and Soren sees that Goran and Farah are both on the call. So Soren thinks Goran thinks Farah thinks the supplier is Brightwater.

ANSWER: B

On the final call, Amara, Soren, and Goran all hear Mirela switch the supplier to Brightwater. Amara therefore believes Soren believes Goran believes Soren believes it is Brightwater.

ANSWER: B

Amara knows Wanjiru was on the call where Xavier switched the supplier to Sablewood, with Soren also present. Amara does not know Wanjiru secretly listened to the later call where Soren read Brightwater, so she has no reason to think Wanjiru’s view of Soren’s belief changed. Amara therefore thinks Wanjiru thinks Soren thinks the supplier is Sablewood.

ANSWER: C

At Oksana’s first reveal of the blue drawer, Dalia, Soren and Xavier are all in the attic and none of them misses it. Farah believes Xavier therefore thinks Soren saw Dalia learn the whistle was in the blue drawer. Farah knows of no later update that Xavier thinks Soren learned about, so the nested belief remains the blue drawer.

ANSWER: C

Dalia is in the attic when Oksana reveals that the whistle is in the blue drawer. Farah misses that reveal, but nobody realizes she missed it, so Farah believes Hana and Oksana think she saw it. From Farah’s perspective, each layer therefore attributes the belief “Dalia thinks it is in the blue drawer” to the next person.

ANSWER: B

Rania’s own view is that the whistle is in the blue drawer. She can tell that Farah believes it is in the white cabinet, from Rania’s text to her, and that Emeka believes it is in the wooden chest, from what he saw before leaving. She has no reason to know about their later private messages.

ANSWER: Farah, Emeka

The padlock is last shown in the grey locker when Uma opens the floor containers. Nothing moves it after that; Wanjiru’s text message only reports a location.

ANSWER: A

On the final call, Mirela switches the supplier to Brightwater. Mirela, Soren, Goran, Xavier and Farah are all present, so Farah believes Xavier knows Goran heard Soren hear Mirela’s update.

ANSWER: D

Yara last learns from Wanjiru’s text that the padlock is in the wicker basket. She has no later information to replace that belief, so she opens the wicker basket first.

ANSWER: C

Yara sees Oksana move the padlock to the wicker basket, and Wanjiru later tells her it is in the wicker basket. She therefore thinks it is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: C

Rania sees Farah move the whistle into the blue drawer while Soren is still in the attic, so Rania thinks Soren believes it is in the blue drawer. But Oksana misses that move. From Oksana’s perspective, Soren’s last relevant move before leaving was putting it in the wooden chest, so she thinks Rania believes Soren thinks it is in the wooden chest. The later announcement that it is in the blue drawer does not update Rania’s belief about what Soren thinks, since Soren is outside.

ANSWER: C

Farah knows Xavier, Soren, Amara, Mirela and Goran heard the final update to Brightwater, so she believes they share her view. She has no later information showing that Wanjiru or Nadim changed their views: as far as Farah can tell, Wanjiru still believes Northwind and Nadim still believes Halcyon.

ANSWER: Nadim, Wanjiru

Pablo sees the whistle moved to the flat tin, then to the square tin, and back to the flat tin. He later sees the tins opened, confirming it is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: B

Jonas saw Uma say the whistle was in the flat tin, then saw her move it to the square tin. He left before Yara moved it back, and learned nothing indicating that Uma later updated her belief. Pablo’s message that it was in the flat tin updated Jonas’s own belief, not his belief about Uma’s.

ANSWER: D

Uma last told Oksana that the padlock was in the wicker basket. Uma does not know that Oksana later saw it there, so she has no reason to update her belief about what Oksana thinks.

ANSWER: C

Dalia and Jonas were both in the garage when Dalia moved the whistle to the flat tin, so Dalia thinks Jonas saw it there and believes it is there. Dalia left before the whistle was moved to the square tin and receives no update that would change her view of Jonas’s belief. Wanjiru saw them there too and knows Dalia left before that move, so Wanjiru thinks Dalia thinks Jonas believes the whistle is in the flat tin.

ANSWER: D

Farah’s nested belief stops at what she knows before leaving; she doesn’t know about the later events. In the belief chain, Dalia is taken to have seen the whistle placed in the wicker basket and then left before Emeka moved it. The later messages tell Dalia locations, but not what Emeka believes. So Dalia is thought to believe that Emeka still thinks it is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: A

Dalia saw Yara move the padlock to the canvas sack while Wanjiru was there, so Oksana believes Dalia thinks Wanjiru thinks it is in the sack. Oksana knows Dalia left before Pablo moved it to the grey locker, and she doesn’t know about Wanjiru’s private text to Dalia.

ANSWER: C

At the start, Dalia saw Rania put the whistle in the wicker basket, along with Soren, Xavier and Emeka. Farah therefore believes Dalia thinks Soren thinks Xavier thinks Emeka thinks it is in the wicker basket.

Farah later tells Dalia it is in the blue drawer, but that updates Dalia’s belief about the whistle’s location—not what she thinks Soren, Xavier or Emeka know. Farah also doesn’t know Dalia secretly watched later events through the window. So Farah’s nested belief remains the wicker basket, even though Xavier says the whistle is in the blue drawer at the end.

ANSWER: A

Jonas saw Uma move the whistle into the square tin, but he left before Yara moved it back to the flat tin. Pablo later told Jonas the whistle was in the flat tin, but Jonas received no information that Uma had seen Yara move it. So Jonas would expect Uma to open the square tin first.

ANSWER: C

Farah knows that Nadim received her message saying Halcyon at event 11. She believes he still thinks Halcyon: the later changes she hears happen on calls Nadim appears not to be on, and she does not know about messages or secret listening that update his view. Nadim, in turn, has reason to believe Farah thinks his view is Halcyon, and that belief about their views continues through the nested chain. Nadim’s own latest information at event 40 also says Halcyon; event 41 is not communicated to him.

ANSWER: C

Nadim believes Halcyon at the end, and Goran also believes Nadim believes Halcyon because he secretly read Mirela’s message to Nadim. But Amara does not know about that secret read or Goran’s private messages to Nadim. From what she knows, Goran and Nadim last learned the supplier together at the call where it was set to Sablewood. Farah likewise has no knowledge that would make her think Amara’s view is different.

ANSWER: D

The latest actual change to the client workshop booking is at step 40, when Chidi moves it to Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Nadim’s actual latest belief is Halcyon: Amara tells him that at #40. But Xavier doesn’t know about that message, and Goran’s private knowledge from reading Nadim’s messages is hidden from Xavier. So Xavier thinks Goran’s view of Nadim’s belief is still based on the shared call where Nadim heard Sablewood. Goran expects Xavier to have that same view, and Farah expects Goran to think so.

ANSWER: D

Oksana learns the offsite is in Turin at event 14. She later hears Zoltan move it to Leeds at event 30. She is not present for the later move back to Turin at event 37, so she still thinks it is in Leeds.

ANSWER: D

Oksana hears at event 30 that the offsite is moved to Leeds. She is not present for the later move to Turin at event 37, so she still believes it is in Leeds and answers honestly.

ANSWER: B

Yara’s latest information is that the client workshop is booked in Room Dogwood: she hears Chidi move it there on the call in step 40, then Oksana tells her the same in step 41.

ANSWER: D

Farah’s view of the nested beliefs does not include the later reveal by Oksana: Farah misses it. She knows Xavier saw Dalia leave before the whistle was moved from the wicker basket, but Xavier did not know about Farah’s private blue-drawer text to Dalia. Farah’s later messages from Emeka and Rania update her own belief about the whistle, not what she thinks Hana, Oksana, Xavier, and Dalia believe.

So in Farah’s model, Xavier thinks Dalia thinks the whistle is in the wicker basket, and the nested beliefs above that preserve that view.

ANSWER: B

Yara hears Chidi say the workshop is booked in Room Alder on call 27, so Goran knows she believes it is in Room Alder. Goran later hears changes while Yara is absent, and doesn’t know she secretly listens to call 40 or receives Oksana’s message. So he still thinks Yara believes the workshop is booked in Room Alder.

ANSWER: A

At event 34, Xavier hears Oksana move the workshop to Room Alder. He receives no later workshop update, and Zoltan knows Xavier was on that call. So Zoltan thinks Xavier believes it is in Room Alder.

ANSWER: D

Goran last knew Yara had heard that the workshop was in Room Alder, during the call at step 24. He doesn’t know about the later message or that Yara secretly listened to step 40, so he expects her to still say Room Alder.

ANSWER: B

Dalia last saw Yara put the padlock in the canvas sack before Dalia left. Zoltan didn’t know about the private messages telling Dalia it was in the grey locker, and he missed the later opening that showed it in the sack. So Zoltan thinks Dalia still thinks it is in the canvas sack. Yara knows Zoltan lacked that private information, and Jonas thinks Yara’s view of Zoltan is the same.

ANSWER: C

Dalia saw Uma present when Dalia moved the whistle to the flat tin, so Wanjiru thinks Dalia thinks Uma believes it is in the flat tin. Pablo saw that too, and saw Wanjiru leave before the later changes. He does not know about Wanjiru’s private message saying it was in the square tin, so Wanjiru thinks Pablo still believes her nested view is “flat tin.”

ANSWER: B

Uma does not know that Zoltan watched her move the whistle or that he later saw Pablo reveal it in the flat tin. The messages that told Zoltan about the whistle were private, so she doesn’t know their contents either. From her perspective, she has no reason to think he knows where it is.

ANSWER: E

On call 40, Yara hears Chidi move the workshop to Room Dogwood and sees that Goran and Oksana are on the call. She therefore believes Goran heard the update, Oksana knows Goran heard it, and Goran knows Oksana heard it. The nested belief is Room Dogwood.

ANSWER: C

At event 30, Chidi hears Zoltan move the offsite to Leeds. Yara and Xavier are both on the call, so Chidi thinks they both hear the update. He therefore thinks Xavier thinks Yara believes the offsite is in Leeds. Chidi’s later offsite move to Turin happens on a call without either of them.

ANSWER: C

At event 27, Rania sees that both Yara and Oksana hear Chidi say the workshop is booked in Room Alder. So Rania thinks Yara thinks Oksana thinks it is in Alder.

Later, Rania learns updates to Oksana’s belief, but Yara is not on those calls. Rania’s message to Yara at event 33 says the room is Dogwood, but does not tell her what Oksana thinks. Rania does not know about Oksana’s later private message to Yara. Thus Rania still thinks Yara believes Oksana thinks Alder.

ANSWER: C

Oksana’s later belief that the padlock is in the wicker basket doesn’t change what Jonas thinks she believes: he left before she moved it there, and he thinks she still believes it is in the canvas sack. Uma and Pablo observed the relevant earlier events, and Dalia receives no later information that would change her view of Pablo’s nested belief.

ANSWER: B

On call 40, Oksana, Chidi, Soren, and Rania all hear Chidi move the workshop to Room Dogwood, and everyone can see who is on the call. So Oksana believes Chidi thinks Soren thinks Rania thinks Soren believes it is in Room Dogwood. No later event changes the workshop room.

ANSWER: B

The last actual movement is Yara moving the torch to the wicker basket. The messages and observations do not change its location.

ANSWER: D

At Dalia’s last shared view with Jonas, Zoltan had left while the padlock was in the canvas sack. Uma, Pablo, and Jonas had no reason to think Zoltan learned otherwise, so the nested belief remains that Zoltan thinks it is in the canvas sack. Dalia’s later messages don’t tell her that Jonas received any new information about the padlock.

ANSWER: B

At call 34, Chidi believes Zoltan heard Oksana move the workshop to Alder, and that Soren heard it too. So Chidi believes Zoltan thinks Soren thinks Oksana thinks it is in Alder. Later, Chidi hears Oksana learn Dogwood at call 40, but Zoltan is not on that call, so Chidi does not think Zoltan learns of the change.

ANSWER: A

Jonas believes the whistle is in the flat tin. As far as he can tell, Wanjiru thinks it is in the round tin, Uma thinks it is in the square tin, Yara thinks it is in the copper tin, and Zoltan has no idea. The others seem to share Jonas’s view.

ANSWER: Wanjiru, Uma, Yara, Zoltan

Uma’s opening shows Yara that the torch is in the green cupboard. Yara then moves it to the wicker basket, so she knows it is there.

ANSWER: C

At call 30, Yara, Chidi, Rania, Zoltan and Oksana all hear Zoltan set the offsite to Leeds. They can see that one another is on the call, so Yara thinks Chidi thinks Rania thinks Zoltan thinks Rania thinks Oksana believes it is in Leeds. Yara does not learn about the later change on call 37.

ANSWER: A

Dalia’s latest information about the padlock is Yara’s text saying it is in the canvas sack, so Dalia thinks it is there. Zoltan did not learn about Dalia’s later updates, so he still thinks Dalia believes it is in the sack. The nested beliefs stay with that location; Wanjiru’s final text to Yara cannot change what Dalia thinks Yara believes.

ANSWER: A

Zoltan saw Uma move the whistle into the square tin, but he did not see Yara later move it back to the flat tin. When he later sees Pablo reveal that the whistle is flat, he learns its current location, but not that Yara learned of that later change. So in Zoltan’s model, Pablo thinks Oksana thinks Yara still thinks it is in the square tin.

ANSWER: A

Oksana’s last information about the torch is the message she secretly reads from Yara, saying it is in the white cabinet. She believes the message, so she opens that container first.

ANSWER: A

Oksana last sees the torch moved to the canvas sack. Later, she reads Yara’s message to Chidi saying it is in the white cabinet, so she updates her belief to the white cabinet. She is not said to see the final move to the wicker basket.

ANSWER: A
ANSWER: E

Jonas last saw the torch in the green cupboard when he moved it there, then left the cellar. Uma sees him leave and knows he cannot see the later changes, so she thinks he still believes it is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: A

Soren’s latest information is seeing Jonas move the torch to the wicker basket. He gets no later update about its location, so he will open the wicker basket first.

ANSWER: C

Yara receives Soren’s message that the torch is in the green cupboard, and she has no reason to think he is misleading her. She doesn’t know he watches the later move to the wicker basket, so she still thinks Soren believes it is in the green cupboard.

ANSWER: B

Zoltan’s latest information is that Goran moved the workshop to Room Fir in call 39. Xavier was not on that call, and Zoltan’s last indication of Xavier’s view was Room Alder. Zoltan missed Oksana’s move in call 34, so his last indication of her view is Room Dogwood from call 32. He therefore considers Xavier and Oksana to disagree. The others he knows about either heard the move to Fir in call 39 or, in Yara’s case, told him Fir.

ANSWER: Xavier, Oksana

Yara believes Keiko saw Chidi move the torch into the white cabinet, since Yara doesn’t know Keiko missed it. Later information that Keiko sees doesn’t update Chidi’s belief, because he is outside. So Yara thinks Keiko still believes Chidi thinks it is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: C

The latest booking change is Bruno moving the workshop to Room Dogwood in step 41.

ANSWER: C

Yara’s most recent update is call 40, when Mirela moves the workshop to Room Birch. Yara is not on the final call, so she learns nothing from it.

ANSWER: B

Yara last saw Soren and Uma together when Jonas’s statement that the torch was in the canvas sack was followed by Yara moving it to the white cabinet. Yara believes Uma saw that move too, so she thinks Uma believes Soren’s newer information is that the torch is in the white cabinet. Soren’s later private message to Yara doesn’t change what Yara thinks Uma knows.

ANSWER: C

Mirela hears Bruno move the workshop to Room Dogwood on the final call, so that replaces her earlier belief that it was in Room Birch.

ANSWER: A

Yara’s latest information is from call 40, when Mirela moved the workshop to Room Birch. Yara doesn’t hear the later change in call 41, so she honestly answers Room Birch.

ANSWER: A

Wanjiru knows Farah and Amara heard Brightwater on call 32, but Goran was absent. Her later message tells Goran only the supplier name, not that Amara and Farah heard it. So Wanjiru doesn’t update her view of Goran’s belief about Amara’s belief about Farah.

In Wanjiru’s view, Amara and Farah’s last shared supplier information was Sablewood on call 2. Wanjiru’s later private message to Farah doesn’t change what Amara thinks Farah believes. The nested belief therefore remains Sablewood.

ANSWER: A

Yara and Zoltan are not aware of the later information that would change their view of Xavier’s knowledge. From Yara’s perspective, Xavier’s latest relevant call with her was the one where he and Oksana heard that the workshop was in Alder, while Goran was absent. She thinks Xavier therefore thinks Goran thinks Oksana believes it is in Alder. Zoltan’s view of Yara’s nested belief is the same.

ANSWER: B

Quinn sees Jonas move the torch to the green cupboard. Since Quinn doesn’t realize Yara missed the move, he thinks Yara saw it and believes the torch is green. He also thinks Jonas believes that about Yara. Quinn has no information that Keiko left the cellar, so he thinks Keiko witnessed Jonas’s move too and shares that view of Jonas’s belief.

ANSWER: C

At event 33, Goran tells Viktor that the workshop is booked in Room Birch. Since people say what they believe, Viktor believes Goran thinks it is in Birch. Viktor learns nothing afterward that changes his view of Goran’s belief.

ANSWER: A

At step 33, Goran tells Viktor the workshop is booked in Room Birch, so Viktor knows Goran believes Birch then. Viktor gets no later information showing that Goran changed his belief; the later calls Goran attends are not calls Viktor hears. Viktor therefore expects Goran to say Room Birch.

ANSWER: B

When Oksana leaves, she has just seen Yara reveal the torch in the wicker basket. Chidi and Uma saw that reveal too, so Soren believes Oksana thinks Chidi thinks Uma believes the torch is in the wicker basket. Soren doesn’t know about Oksana’s later private messages or window-watching, so Yara and then Uma retain that view of Soren’s belief.

ANSWER: B

Jonas believes the torch is in the green cupboard. As far as he can tell, Uma, Yara and Keiko also believe it is there. He believes Quinn and Oksana still think it is in the wicker basket, Chidi believes it is in the wicker basket from Jonas’s text, and Soren thinks it is in the white cabinet.

ANSWER: Quinn, Oksana, Chidi, Soren

When Yara showed the torch in the wicker basket, Oksana and Chidi both saw it, and Chidi saw that Oksana saw it. So Chidi’s view is that Oksana thinks Yara thinks the torch is in the wicker basket. Uma and Yara saw this shared evidence too. The later messages that could change this chain were private, so Uma and Chidi don’t know about the relevant updates.

ANSWER: D

At event 39, Yara and Zoltan both hear Bruno move the workshop to Dogwood, so Zoltan knows Yara thinks it is in Dogwood. Yara later hears Birch at event 40, but Zoltan is not on that call and receives no update. Ines knows Zoltan missed it, so she thinks he still believes Yara thinks Dogwood.

ANSWER: D

Yara thinks Quinn left the cellar before the later events and therefore did not see Chidi receive any subsequent information about the torch. Quinn saw Chidi witness Jonas put it in the green cupboard, then saw Chidi leave before Uma moved it. So Yara thinks Quinn thinks Uma thinks Chidi still believes it is in the green cupboard. Yara doesn’t know Quinn secretly watched through the window, and her later text to him doesn’t tell him what Uma thinks Chidi believes.

ANSWER: A

Yara knows Viktor heard Ines move the workshop to Room Alder on call 5. She knows of no later information that changed his belief: the later calls she hears do not include him, and she does not know about his secret listening or the private messages he receives. So she thinks Viktor still believes it is in Room Alder.

ANSWER: C

The harmonica’s last move is Viktor moving it to the tall tin. No later event moves it again, so it is still there.

ANSWER: D

At event 34, Zoltan, Yara, and Mirela are all on the call when Ines moves the workshop to Room Elm. Bruno sees that they are all there, so he thinks Zoltan knows Yara heard the change and knows Mirela heard it too. Later changes happen on calls Zoltan isn’t visibly on, and Bruno doesn’t know about any secret listening or message-reading.

So Bruno thinks Zoltan thinks Yara thinks Mirela believes the workshop is booked in Room Elm.

ANSWER: B

Mirela knows Yara and Viktor were both on the call when Ines moved the workshop to Room Alder in event 5, so she thinks Yara believes Viktor thinks it is booked in Alder. Mirela believes Yara missed the later updates that Viktor heard.

ANSWER: A

Goran last sees the stopwatch revealed in the wicker basket, then Viktor texts him that it is there. He doesn’t see the later reveal of the blue drawer, so he thinks it is in the wicker basket.

ANSWER: C

Goran’s latest information is that the stopwatch is in the wicker basket: he saw Keiko reveal it there, and Viktor later texted him the same location. Goran does not see Chidi’s later reveal from outside the garage.

ANSWER: B

Xavier last saw the harmonica in the copper tin when he moved it there. Nadim later texted him that it was in the tall tin, so Xavier believes it is there.

ANSWER: D
ANSWER: B

Xavier hears Hana say that the stopwatch is in the wooden chest while Ines is there. He later sees Ines leave before the stopwatch is moved to the wicker basket, and doesn’t know she watches from outside. So he thinks Ines still believes it is in the wooden chest.

ANSWER: D

Uma’s view is Room Elm. As far as she can tell, Goran, Ines and Bruno also think it is Elm. She knows Viktor was told Birch, and that Mirela, Yara and Zoltan last heard Birch on the call at step 28.

ANSWER: Viktor, Mirela, Yara, Zoltan

Goran’s deepest attribution leads back to Room Cedar. Goran does not know about call 31, where Soren heard Yara, Oksana and Chidi hear Alder. From Goran’s perspective, Chidi missed the later public update Yara heard, so the nested belief about what Yara thinks remains at the earlier Cedar information.

ANSWER: B

Ines sees Goran move the harmonica to the flat tin, so she believes he knows it is there. She gets no later information that would change her view of his belief.

ANSWER: C

Yara ends up thinking Room Birch after hearing Mirela’s update in call 40. Goran hears that update too, and Yara is absent from call 41, so he thinks she still thinks Birch. Zoltan actually updates his view at call 34, but Uma doesn’t learn about that call; her latest basis for Zoltan’s nested belief is the shared call 6, where Goran, Yara and Zoltan all hear Birch.

ANSWER: D
ANSWER: A

At event 15, Zoltan is on the call and believes Ines heard Bruno move the workshop to Room Elm, since nobody realizes she missed it. Viktor, Mirela, Uma and Bruno are also on that call, so Zoltan believes Ines thinks Bruno knows Viktor, Mirela and Uma all heard that update.

Later updates that Ines and Bruno hear are not heard by Viktor in their view, so Bruno’s attributed belief about Viktor’s view of Mirela’s view of Uma’s belief remains Room Elm.

ANSWER: A

Yara knows that on call 5, Uma, Mirela and Viktor all heard the workshop moved to Alder. On call 6, Uma and Mirela heard it moved to Birch, but Viktor was absent, so Yara thinks Uma believes Mirela still thinks Viktor believes Mirela thinks Alder. Later information Yara gets updates Mirela’s room belief, but doesn’t tell her that Uma’s view of Viktor’s knowledge changed.

ANSWER: A

At call 5, Goran sees Bruno, Ines, Yara and Uma all hear Ines move the workshop to Room Alder. So Goran believes Bruno believes Ines believes Yara believes Uma believes it is booked in Alder.

The later call where Bruno, Ines, Yara and Uma hear Birch is call 28, which Goran misses. His later calls with Yara and Ines do not include Uma, so they don’t tell him that Yara’s belief about Uma changed.

ANSWER: A

When Keiko moves the stopwatch to the wooden chest, Goran sees both Viktor and Hana there, so Goran believes Viktor thinks Hana believes it is in the wooden chest. Goran later learns that Viktor believes it is in the wicker basket, but he gets no information that would update his belief about what Viktor thinks Hana believes.

ANSWER: B
